svg.title: From Foundry Resource to Client App
svg.desc: A Foundry resource provides models, quotas, security and governance shared by the team. It contains Foundry projects, each a workspace for one solution with its agents, evaluations, files and connections. In a project: step 1, deploy a model from the model catalog, choosing a deployment name, deployment type and tokens-per-minute limit. Step 2, test it in the playground with a system prompt and parameters, and compare models. Step 3, optionally save it as an agent: model plus instructions plus tools such as file search, code interpreter and web search. Step 4, a client app calls it through the project endpoint with AIProjectClient, get_openai_client and responses.create, passing either the deployment name or an agent reference. The client can also call the tested model deployment directly without an agent.
svg.text: From Foundry Resource to Client App
One resource holds many projects; inside a project you deploy, test, optionally build an agent, then call it.
Models, quotas, security and governance shared by the team
Workspace for one solution: agents, evaluations, files, connections
Calls the agent, or the model deployment
